remarks: Just minutes from downtown Greenwich, this beautifully renovated Colonial offers the ideal blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. The bright, open interior features soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, a custom kitchen with stone countertops and stainless steel appliances, and an impressive great room with fireplace overlooking the backyard. Designed for today's lifestyle, all bedrooms feature en-suite baths, including a flexible first-floor primary suite ideal for multigenerational living, guests, or an au pair. The second-floor primary retreat offers a fireplace and private balcony overlooking the heated saltwater pool. Set on level, professionally landscaped grounds, this move-in-ready home is an exceptional offering in one of Greenwich's most desirable locations.
